description: Add a card that is NOT in the CreditSync catalog for application eligibility tracking (Chase 5/24, Amex 2/90). Use this for cards the user holds that CreditSync does not track benefits for (e.g., store cards, non-premium cards). Business cards are automatically excluded from Chase 5/24 count but still tracked for reference. Always set is_business correctly — it affects eligibility calculations.

is_business.description: Whether this is a business card (default false). Business cards do NOT count toward Chase 5/24.

open_date.description: Date the card was opened, YYYY-MM-DD format

name: add_external_card
